Looking for something specific? Auctions & distress, waterfront, flagged properties and long-term rents each have their own tab, covering the full 100-mile ring rather than the slice shown here.

Scope notes. Radius expanded to 100 miles on 2026-08-04 at Shawn's instruction (was 50 since 2026-07-20). The 2026-08-04 expansion swept the four strongest new markets for second-dwelling and multifamily inventory only: Indiana Dunes (LaPorte + Porter Co.), Harbor Country/SW Michigan (Berrien Co.), Starved Rock West (LaSalle–Peru–Utica–Streator zips), and Danville/Vermilion Co. Not yet swept (queued for the weekly screen): Champaign, Bloomington-Normal, West Lafayette, South Bend (edge), Kenosha (edge), Rockford, DeKalb, and single-family sweeps plus cash/distress lanes in all new areas. St. Joseph/Benton Harbor/Niles sit at the ~96–97 mi edge and are badged. City of Kankakee AND City of Joliet listings are excluded at Shawn's request (Joliet added 2026-08-04), except West Kankakee by the river, which is allowed (2026-10-23); rural unincorporated parcels with Kankakee mailing addresses are labeled and toggleable. Chicago and Gary, IN are skipped entirely at Shawn's request (2026-10-23). New-market revenue bases are documented per card (proxy discounts for towns without AirDNA pages; amenity-skew flags where beach houses drive the average). No demographic data is used anywhere in this system. Estimates are AirDNA market-average screens — Rentalizer + inspection before any offer; verify each town's STR permit and licensing rules (New Buffalo caps licenses).

Two units or more — where the best deals are

Every property on the board that gives you more than one rentable unit for one purchase: guest houses, in-law suites, coach houses, second cottages and related-living layouts, together with 2-flats, duplexes and small multifamily buildings. These are counted as one category because they are one idea — a second income on a single parcel. Ranked by yield in the current tab's lens, and every unit counts toward revenue. This section ranks across the whole 100-mile board — distance never pushes a higher yield down, it is shown on each card instead.

Minimum yield:

Vacation Rental Deal Analyzer 5.0 results

One filled workbook per 1%+ property (folder: Agent OS › 01 Projects › Airbnb Acquisitions › Analyzers). Financed at 80% LTV / 30-yr / 7.0% APR. Sorted by cash-on-cash. Basis since 2026-07-26 (Shawn's standing rule — every analyzer, every time): nightly rates come from AirDNA market data verified against live Airbnb comps for the property's actual class. Headline market ADRs are set by amenity properties (lakefront, pools, hot tubs, arcade rooms); ordinary homes book at roughly half those averages, and these numbers reflect that. Occupancy = AirDNA market average, i.e., a full-time, well-run listing. Watseka rows: no local comps exist — regional floor rates, STR demand unproven. Board yields remain the separate conservative revenue-average screen. Rentalizer per address before any offer.

How every number was built

Revenue estimate

AirDNA market average monthly revenue × size multiplier (1BR ×0.70 → 5+BR ×1.70); second dwellings add their own multiplier. Towns without AirDNA pages borrow the nearest market at a discount.
Yieldest. rev ÷ price
Pass≥ 1.0%/mo
Water section≥ 0.7%/mo

Honesty system

  • Turnkey-verified — listing documents a recent full renovation
  • Condition unverified — confirm with agent
  • Flagged — as-is / rehab-priced / auction / code issues, stated verbatim
  • Cash only — verified wording; "cash or conventional" doesn't count

Database, not a report

Properties are keyed by address and remembered — new screens only research what's new, and every property keeps first-seen / last-seen dates and price history so price-change watching can be added later. Favorites and notes live in C:\Users\shawn\Code\airbnb-hq\data.
